en.description:
Pyramyst is an app built for watchOS that turns spare seconds into satisfying puzzles. Spin the Digital Crown to crack intricate dials, feel crisp haptics at each detent, and race a draining hourglass as you uncover ancient relics buried beneath desert pyramids. Designed for micro-sessions, Pyramyst fits the moments between things such us waiting in line, riding an elevator, or taking a quick break.

How it plays
- Turn the Digital Crown to align rings with precise and tactile feedback.
- Beat the hourglass timer to “unlock” the mechanism and claim the relic.
- Collect artifacts, improve your best times, and jump straight into another quick run.

Why it fits your wrist
- Glanceable & fast: Most sessions finish in ~10 - 25 seconds.
- Crown-first control: Confident, one-handed play that feels native to Apple Watch.
- Satisfying feedback: Clean visuals, crisp haptics, and subtle audio (if enabled).
- Zero friction: No accounts, no ads, no lengthy tutorials, just play.
- Stop anytime: Auto-save and instant restarts keep the flow effortless.

Features
- Puzzle runs tailored for short bursts of free time.
- Themed relic collection to mark your progress.
- Offline by design, play anywhere without a connection.
- Simple inputs (Crown + tap) and readable UI for comfortable on-wrist play.

Privacy 
Pyramyst does not collect personal data or use third-party analytics. Your progress and settings are stored locally on your device.

No ads. No accounts. Just quick, crown-driven fun you can play anytime

Next version update:
1. Endless Mode
2. More Relics

Stay Tuned !!
